item.title: La FIFA sanciona a España por cánticos islamófobos en el amistoso contra Egipto
item.description: La Real Federación Española de Fútbol ha sido multada con 20.000 dólares y deberá cerrar parcialmente su estadio en el próximo amistoso masculino después de que aficionados corearan consignas islamófobas en dos ocasiones durante un partido contra Egipto en marzo, informó la FIFA en un comunicado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Real Federación Española de Fútbol ha sido multada con 20.000 dólares y deberá cerrar parcialmente su estadio en el próximo amistoso masculino después de que aficionados corearan consignas islamófobas en dos ocasiones durante un partido contra Egipto en marzo, informó la FIFA en un comunicado. Las sanciones se refieren a los incidentes ocurridos en el RCDE Stadium, cerca de Barcelona, sede del Espanyol, donde algunos aficionados españoles corearon "musulmán el que no bote" durante un partido de preparación para el Mundial que terminó con un empate 0-0. Tras la segunda repetición del cántico, el encargado de la megafonía del estadio emitió una advertencia y el marcador mostró un mensaje contra las conductas discriminatorias. El extremo de la selección española Lamine Yamal, que es musulmán, condenó entonces los cánticos, que calificó de irrespetuosos e intolerables, y llamó "ignorantes y racistas" a los responsables. La policía española abrió una investigación al día siguiente, mientras que la FIFA, organismo rector del fútbol mundial, inició posteriormente un procedimiento disciplinario contra la Real Federación Española de Fútbol (RFEF). La RFEF alegó que la palabra "musulmán" no era "ni insultante ni peyorativa" y añadió que la conducta de los aficionados debía evaluarse conforme al artículo 17 de la normativa de la FIFA, que abarca los mensajes políticos, ideológicos, religiosos u ofensivos, y no al artículo 15, relativo a la discriminación y los insultos racistas. Sin embargo, la Comisión Disciplinaria de la FIFA rechazó ese argumento y señaló que el artículo 15 no exige el uso explícito de un término insultante y que una palabra puede ser discriminatoria cuando se utiliza en un contexto como "un insulto, una burla o una señal de inferioridad". La FIFA multó a la RFEF y ordenó el cierre de al menos el 15% de las localidades disponibles para el próximo amistoso de España. La RFEF no respondió inmediatamente una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters.

item.title: IMF chief urges cooperation on AI and war risks, as US hails economic momentum
item.description: The head of the IMF on Friday appealed to global leaders to cooperate in the face of multiple economic risks, including rapid advances in AI and a prolonged war in the Middle East, as Washington hailed what it sees as US-led economic momentum.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: The head of the IMF on Friday appealed to global leaders to cooperate in the face of multiple economic risks, including rapid advances in AI and a prolonged war in the Middle East, as Washington hailed what it sees as US-led economic momentum. Their contrasting views echoed throughout this year's annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok, as finance officials and central bankers from around the world took stock of a global economy rocked by high inflation and rising interest rates that have kept growth sluggish and increased inequality. The IMF on Tuesday slightly raised its global growth forecast [USN:L1N45Z05I TEXT:"to 3.1% in 2026"], well below the historical average, as it flagged significant growth and financial stability risks from a potential ending of the AI investment boom, growing debt levels and the ongoing Middle East conflict. Absent the US-Israeli-led war against Iran and Tehran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz that triggered a massive global energy shock, the IMF has said it would have expected AI to have fueled much stronger growth. On Friday, IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said the sheer speed of technological change added to the long list of challenges, including disruptions to the global trading system, high food and energy prices and lingering wars, all of which threatened to widen the gulf between advanced economies and the world's poor. Bond markets, she said, were clearly sensing the risks, with US, German and Japanese 10-year sovereign yields reaching their highest levels in decades. "The need of the hour is for urgent and practical international cooperation," Georgieva, the first IMF chief from an emerging market economy, said at a plenary session on Friday. She told a subsequent panel that she spent sleepless nights worrying about how to regulate AI and ensure that poorer countries weren't left behind by its breakneck-speed development. US Treasury Under Secretary Erin Browne, in a call with reporters, pushed back against those warnings, hailing record highs on the US stock market, strong US economic output and improvements in Japan's economy. "The IMF needs to take a more balanced approach to assessing the global economic outlook," she said, adding: "The global economy has demonstrated significant resilience with strong US growth helping to support broader economic and financial stability." She said that the Fund should give equal consideration to "opportunities for positive economic shocks, particularly those driven by American innovation and super intelligence, energy abundance, and productivity-enhancing reforms." US President Donald Trump's policies on tax, trade, energy and deregulation were paving the way for stronger investment, higher productivity and durable economic growth, she said. AI JITTERS HIT STOCKS Emerging market stocks have been volatile in recent weeks, roiled by expectations of higher US interest rates that have sent borrowing costs sharply higher. Major markets have also been hit by the growing concerns over the AI investment cycle. South Korean shares posted their [USN:L1N46207L TEXT:"biggest weekly fall in 18 years"] as investors questioned the sustainability of the AI boom, while Japan's stock market [USN:L1N46207K TEXT:"lost 5.4%"] over the week. Eli Remolona, governor of the Philippines' Bangko Sentral ng Pilipanas, said in an IMF panel discussion earlier in the week that he was concerned Asia had [USN:L1N46001T TEXT:"not learned the lessons"] of its destructive financial crisis in the late 1990s. Before the Asian financial crisis broke out in 1997, economies drew huge capital inflows that prompted the World Bank to describe it as the "East Asian miracle," Remolona said. "Investment poured into Asia, and then you had the crisis because it wasn't really a miracle. I think we have to remind ourselves about that. We have to guard against that kind of crisis," he said on Wednesday. "We have not really been making a lot of effort looking at that kind of crisis." Illustrating the vulnerability to sudden shifts, Indonesian stocks fell 11.6% on Friday, their [USN:L4N4620NX TEXT:"steepest one-day fall in 28 years"], after global index provider MSCI said the Indonesian market was no longer worthy of "emerging market" status. Officials at the IMF and World Bank this week said they are seeing elevated demand for grant and loan programs. IMF strategy chief Christian Mummsen said the IMF's low-interest lending to low-income countries had quadrupled since the COVID pandemic, and demand was expected to remain strong. About 60% of the IMF's financing since COVID had gone to low-income countries, he said. Developing countries are increasingly outspoken about their concerns. Barbados this week joined a group of countries calling for the creation of [USN:L4N4600BS TEXT:"an international panel to address inequality"], citing geopolitical tensions, climate change and rapid technological advances that could further divide wealthy and poorer nations.

item.title: Panzani, Cerealis in talks to create €1.8 billion European food group
item.description: French pasta maker Panzani and Portugal's Cerealis are in exclusive talks to combine their operations in a deal valuing the merged business at about €1.8 billion ($2.03 billion), they said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French pasta maker Panzani and Portugal's Cerealis are in exclusive talks to combine their operations in a deal valuing the merged business at about €1.8 billion ($2.03 billion), they said on Friday. The proposed deal reflects a broader push for consolidation in Europe's food sector as manufacturers seek greater scale to cope with rising costs, strengthen their bargaining power with retailers and expand across regional markets. The deal would create a European food group with about €1 billion in annual revenue and nearly 1,800 employees, the companies said Panzani, which is controlled by private equity firm CVC, generated €620 million of revenue in 2025. Cerealis, controlled by its founding families and Belgian investment company Sofina (SOF.BR) , reported revenue of €400 million Panzani and Cerealis would remain headquartered in Lyon and Porto respectively and retain operational autonomy The merged group would be owned by Cerealis' existing shareholders, including the Moreira da Silva and Silva Domingues families and Sofina, alongside CVC Capital Partners, which would keep a minority stake Cerealis' Executive Vice Chairman Pedro Moreira da Silva would lead the combined group, while Panzani CEO Albert Mathieu would oversee Panzani and its Central European operations. Cerealis CEO Paula Meireles would manage its Iberian and international private-label business ($1 = 0.8887 euros)

item.title: Rússia assume controle de mais ativos de empresas da UE por apoio à Ucrânia
item.description: A Rússia assumiu o controle dos ativos locais de quatro empresas de França, Alemanha, Suécia e Bélgica, de acordo com um decreto do presidente Vladimir Putin, em retaliação ao apoio prestado pela Europa à Ucrânia durante a guerra.
item.dc:creator: Gleb Bryanski
item.content:encoded: A Rússia assumiu o controle dos ativos locais de quatro empresas de França, Alemanha, Suécia e Bélgica, de acordo com um decreto do presidente Vladimir Putin, em retaliação ao apoio prestado pela Europa à Ucrânia durante a guerra. O decreto de quinta-feira listou ativos pertencentes à fabricante francesa de pisos Tarkett, à fabricante alemã de embalagens Menshen, à fabricante sueca de embalagens Sverige International Holdings e à empresa belga de produtos de higiene Ontex (ONTEX.BR) . O decreto também listou os ativos russos da antiga empresa europeia de embalagens metálicas Eviosys, adquirida pelo grupo norte-americano de embalagens Sonoco (SON.N) em dezembro de 2024. O decreto listou os ativos como de propriedade da unidade holandesa da Sonoco. Os líderes da UE se uniram em apoio ao presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy em uma cúpula na sexta-feira, em um dos momentos mais difíceis para a Ucrânia, em meio a temores de que os EUA possam suspender o compartilhamento de informações de inteligência e o apoio com armas a Kiev. O Kremlin afirmou que a tomada de controle dos ativos deu continuidade a uma tendência, após medida semelhante no mês passado contra a gigante alimentícia Nestlé (NESN.S) e as redes de varejo Auchan e Metro (B4B0n.H) . “O país de origem foi um dos fatores levados em consideração na tomada da decisão”, disse o porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, acrescentando que esses países estavam envolvidos em “expropriações ilegais de propriedades russas”. A administração temporária dos bens das empresas europeias foi transferida para empresas russas até então praticamente desconhecidas. A Ontex, que emprega 350 pessoas na Rússia e opera uma fábrica nos arredores de Moscou, informou que foi notificada sobre o decreto e que “considerará medidas adequadas para salvaguardar seus ativos e a continuidade das operações da Ontex Rússia”. A Sonoco afirmou em seu relatório de 2025 que havia concluído sua saída da Rússia em 2022, mas adquiriu mais ativos — representando 0,5% do total da empresa — como parte do negócio com a Eviosys. A Tarkett disse que estava “perdendo o controle efetivo sobre suas operações na Rússia” e que estava avaliando a situação. O Kremlin afirmou que as medidas respondiam ao envolvimento dos países da UE em “hostilidades diretas no campo de batalha”, mas que também eram “reversíveis”.

item.title: Hungría y Ucrania acuerdan restablecer sus relaciones, según Magyar
item.description: Budapest y Kiev acordaron sentar nuevas bases para sus relaciones, según declaró el viernes el primer ministro húngaro, Peter Magyar, tras reunirse con el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, en un intento de los líderes por calmar las tensiones en torno a los derechos de las minorías.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Budapest y Kiev acordaron sentar nuevas bases para sus relaciones, según declaró el viernes el primer ministro húngaro, Peter Magyar, tras reunirse con el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, en un intento de los líderes por calmar las tensiones en torno a los derechos de las minorías. Magyar ha adoptado una postura menos conflictiva hacia Kiev que su predecesor, Viktor Orbán. Sin embargo, ha afirmado en repetidas ocasiones que Hungría no enviará armas a Ucrania y ha exigido avances en materia de derechos de su minoría étnica húngara. "Le aseguré al presidente ucraniano mi plena solidaridad ante la inhumana agresión rusa contra su país", escribió Magyar en una publicación de Facebook tras lo que calificó como su primera reunión bilateral oficial con Zelenski en Bruselas. Magyar también afirmó que Hungría está dispuesta a ayudar a Ucrania por todos los medios diplomáticos posibles para alcanzar un alto el fuego y una paz duradera. Zelenski calificó la reunión de "muy buena" y señaló que ambos líderes abordaron numerosos asuntos. También afirmó que "no le importaría" visitar Budapest. El acercamiento entre Hungría y Ucrania es fundamental para el respaldo de la Unión Europea a Kiev en la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania. El ex primer ministro Orbán se había opuesto al envío de miles de millones de euros en ayuda a Ucrania y a su adhesión a la Unión Europea. Orbán convirtió el escepticismo hacia el apoyo a Ucrania en su guerra con Rusia en un pilar central de su campaña de cara a las elecciones de abril, que pusieron fin a su mandato como primer ministro tras 16 años. El martes, Ucrania dio un paso adelante en su aspiración a la adhesión a la UE al iniciar conversaciones con el bloque sobre el mercado interior y las normas de competitividad, después de que Hungría retirara sus objeciones.

item.title: L'Iran exporte du GPL et du kérosène malgré le blocus américain, selon des données
item.description: L’Iran a réussi à exporter quelques cargaisons de gaz de pétrole liquéfié (GPL) et de kérosène depuis juillet, malgré le blocus naval américain, selon des données de suivi du trafic maritime et des sources spécialisées dans la sécurité.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L’Iran a réussi à exporter quelques cargaisons de gaz de pétrole liquéfié (GPL) et de kérosène depuis juillet, malgré le blocus naval américain, selon des données de suivi du trafic maritime et des sources spécialisées dans la sécurité. Ces dernières semaines, Téhéran a dissimulé ces cargaisons parmi un volume croissant de transferts de navire à navire effectués par d’autres producteurs du Golfe au large d’Oman, ont déclaré à Reuters quatre spécialistes de la sécurité maritime qui suivent les mouvements pétroliers dans le Golfe. Les exportations iraniennes et la méthode employée sont rapportées ici pour la première fois. Bien qu’elles ne représentent qu’une fraction de ses anciennes exportations énergétiques, ces cargaisons constituent une rare preuve que des produits pétroliers parviennent à franchir un blocus qui a interrompu les exportations de brut iranien. Selon l’analyse du groupe américain United Against Nuclear Iran (UANI), qui surveille le trafic des pétroliers iraniens, au moins huit transporteurs du GPL iranien ont quitté le golfe d’Oman depuis la mi-juillet. Un autre pétrolier transportant du kérosène iranien a atteint le Myanmar en septembre, selon des images satellites analysées par le groupe de renseignement maritime SynMax. Six des huit navires gaziers, ainsi que celui transportant du kérosène, font l’objet de sanctions américaines pour avoir acheminé des produits pétroliers et pétrochimiques iraniens, selon une analyse de Reuters. "Nous avons observé le passage de quelques pétroliers transportant du GPL iranien, mais l’écrasante majorité des navires chargés de produits iraniens ont été détournés par les forces américaine", a déclaré Jemima Shelley, analyste principale à l’UANI. Selon Jemima Shelley, certains navires transportant du GPL iranien ont transbordé leur cargaison au large des villes côtières omanaises de Shinas et de Sohar, tandis que d’autres ont attendu dans le golfe d’Oman avant de contourner le blocus américain, qui, selon le Commandement central américain, s’étend dans le golfe d’Oman, à proximité de la frontière entre l’Iran et le Pakistan. Le volume total de ces cargaisons de GPL a été estimé à 4,1 millions de barils, selon Jemima Shelley. Elle a précisé que ces expéditions relevaient "davantage de l’opportunisme" que d’une nouvelle tendance consistant, pour l’Iran, à tenter d’exporter son pétrole et ses produits pétrochimiques à l’aide de navires plus petits. La plupart des cargaisons ont fait route vers les limites extérieures du port oriental de Malaisie afin d’y effectuer d’autres transferts STS vers des destinations probables en Chine, a déclaré Jemima Shelley, en se basant sur l’analyse de l’UANI. Le gouvernement iranien n’a pas répondu à une demande de commentaires. Le gouvernement soutenu par l’armée au Myanmar n’a pas répondu à une demande de commentaires concernant la réception éventuelle de kérosène iranien par le pays. L'ARMÉE AMÉRICAINE AFFIRME QUE LE BLOCUS EST "INFAILLIBLE" Le Commandement central américain (CENTCOM) a déclaré que son blocus naval, instauré le 13 avril aux exportations de pétrole liées à l’Iran, est "infaillible". Suspendu en juin après l’émergence d’un projet d’accord avec l’Iran, il a été rétabli le 14 juillet après l’échec des négociations. Un responsable militaire américain a déclaré à Reuters que le passage d’un navire ne signifiait pas nécessairement qu’il avait contourné le blocus. Chaque navire était évalué individuellement, notamment sur la base de ses documents, et certains navires pouvaient être autorisés à passer pour des raisons humanitaires. Le Centcom a indiqué dans un communiqué du 13 octobre qu’au cours des trois mois du dernier blocus, quatre navires commerciaux avaient été mis hors d’état de naviguer et 135 navires avaient été refoulés par les forces américaines. La semaine dernière, Washington a imposé de nouvelles sanctions à 17 navires impliqués dans le transport de pétrole brut, de produits pétrochimiques et de produits pétroliers iraniens. Un porte-parole du Trésor américain a remis en cause les données maritimes suggérant que des navires avaient contourné le blocus, affirmant que ceux-ci pouvaient falsifier leur position ou utiliser de fausses identités lors du chargement. Ces données "doivent être prises avec des pincettes", a déclaré le porte-parole. Le porte-parole du Trésor a déclaré que l’opération "Economic Outcast", associée au blocus, "asphyxiait le régime iranien". "Si l’Iran parvient à faire passer des pétroliers, même en petit nombre, le kérosène pourrait constituer une bonne option. L’industrie aéronautique iranienne subit une pression croissante due aux sanctions américaines, avec un nombre croissant d’avions cloués au sol et un excédent potentiel de kérosène dans les raffineries iraniennes", a déclaré Torbjorn Soltvedt, analyste principal du Moyen-Orient chez Verisk Maplecroft Les exportations de pétrole brut iranien sont tombées à zéro en septembre, selon Kpler, pour la première fois depuis le début du suivi des exportations par la société, en 2013. Le secrétaire au Trésor américain, Scott Bessent, a déclaré que le blocus avait empêché la plupart des achats chinois de pétrole iranien et privé l’Iran de la possibilité de livrer du pétrole brut à ses clients.

item.title: La santé du pape Léon en "amélioration constante", dit le Vatican
item.description: Le pape Léon XIV continue de se remettre de son intervention chirurgicale subie mardi pour un nodule cancéreux au poumon, a déclaré vendredi le Vatican, soulignant "l'amélioration constante" de son état de santé.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le pape Léon XIV continue de se remettre de son intervention chirurgicale subie mardi pour un nodule cancéreux au poumon, a déclaré vendredi le Vatican, soulignant "l'amélioration constante" de son état de santé. Selon un communiqué du Vatican, le souverain pontife est désormais capable d'effectuer ses activités quotidiennes normales en toute autonomie, et fera dimanche sa première apparition publique depuis son hospitalisation pour prononcer la traditionnelle prière de l'Angélus. Les préparatifs en vue de son voyage prévu en novembre en Amérique du Sud se poursuivent, a-t-il précisé.

item.title: Ukraine Attaques de drones russes sur plusieurs villes, dont Kharkiv, au moins trois morts
item.description: Des attaques de drones russes ont fait au moins trois morts vendredi en Ukraine, deux à Kharkiv, la deuxième ville du pays, et un dans la région de Volyn (nord-ouest), ont rapporté les autorités.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des attaques de drones russes ont fait au moins trois morts vendredi en Ukraine, deux à Kharkiv, la deuxième ville du pays, et un dans la région de Volyn (nord-ouest), ont rapporté les autorités. Trois secteurs de Kharkiv ont été bombardés, a déclaré le gouverneur de l'oblast, Oleh Syniehoubov, qui avait fait état de trois morts dans un premier temps. Les attaques ont fait également 12 blessés. Dans l'oblast de Volyn, limitrophe de la Pologne, une frappe de drone sur une usine de conditionnement alimentaire a fait un mort et huit blessés, a rapporté le gouverneur Roman Romaniouk. Le réseau électrique a également été ciblé dans la région où quelque 370.000 foyers ont été privés de courant. Roman Romaniouk a précisé que le courant avait été rétabli en fin de matinée pour environ 100.000 usagers. La capitale de l'oblast de Volyn, Loutsk, est également touchée. Selon le maire Andriy Razoumovsky, qui s'exprime sur Facebook, les difficultés d'alimentation pourraient durer au moins 24 heures. Les attaques russes ont également visé deux centres commerciaux - un à Soumy (nord) et un dans l'oblast voisin de Rivne, selon les autorités. On ignore si l'attaque a fait des victimes à Soumy, mais des photos des services de secours montrent des traces de sang sur le sol du centre commercial. A Rivne, sept personnes ont été blessées, a précisé le gouverneur Oleksandr Koval.

item.title: La producción de petróleo de la OPEP aumentó en septiembre, según una encuesta de Reuters
item.description: La producción de petróleo de la OPEP aumentó en septiembre, según una encuesta de Reuters, impulsada por el incremento registrado en Arabia Saudita e Irak, a pesar de las continuas restricciones a las exportaciones debidas a la guerra en Irán y al bloqueo estadounidense sobre los envíos iraníes.
item.dc:creator: Alex Lawler
item.content:encoded: La producción de petróleo de la OPEP aumentó en septiembre, según una encuesta de Reuters, impulsada por el incremento registrado en Arabia Saudita e Irak, a pesar de las continuas restricciones a las exportaciones debidas a la guerra en Irán y al bloqueo estadounidense sobre los envíos iraníes. La encuesta reveló que la producción de crudo de los 11 miembros de la Organización de Países Exportadores de Petróleo (OPEP) aumentó en 1,78 millones de barriles por día (bpd) con respecto al mes anterior, a 21,49 millones de bpd. Siete miembros del grupo de productores de la OPEP+, que incluye a aliados como Rusia, habían acordado aumentar el bombeo en septiembre, pero el conflicto en Oriente Medio lo hizo imposible. La encuesta de Reuters se basa en datos de empresas que realizan un seguimiento de los flujos, así como en información facilitada por fuentes de las compañías petroleras, la OPEP y consultoras.

item.title: Thousands march in Albanian capital as anti-government protests spread
item.description: Thousands of young Albanians marched through Tirana on Friday, breaking some windows and traffic lights on the fourth day of an increasingly violent student-led campaign to force Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Thousands of young Albanians marched through Tirana on Friday, breaking some windows and traffic lights on the fourth day of an increasingly violent student-led campaign to force Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign. The demonstrations, which are spreading through the country, [USN:L1N4610AQ TEXT:"turned into a riot"] in the capital on Thursday, with protesters smashing windows, raiding a bank and clashing with police. They follow months of mostly peaceful demonstrations that the students say the government ignored. "They are pushing us to the limits," said 19-year-old protester Enea, declining to give a second name for fear of arrest. He said his message to Rama was: "To resign as fast as possible before everything burns down." The students accuse officials of corruption and neglecting education and say they are angry about the sale of pristine parts of Albania's coast to a luxury resort development backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner. The unrest is a challenge for Rama, who won a fourth term last year on promises to take Albania into the European Union and is aiming for membership as early as 2028. "We will not bow to violence," he said on Facebook. BUSINESSES APPEAL TO PROTESTERS TO LEAVE THEM ALONE The students, many wearing masks, faced off against lines of riot police in front of the Education Ministry building. Some small businesses had their shutters down and notes on their facades saying: "We are with you. Do not damage our business all over the town." In the coastal town of Lezha, police clashed with stone-hurling protesters. Protests have also spread to Elbasan, Skhodra and Korca, where demonstrators broke windows and set fire to garbage bins, local media reported. "We've been protesting peacefully for 140 days, and nothing was heard. So this is our only chance to be heard and get our rights that we deserve," a 19-year-old protester who gave her name only as Klea said. The demonstrations were sparked by the plans to build the resort, which has faced legal challenges. Villagers told Reuters in July that their land was wrongfully sold for development. Reuters later reported that the man who sold the land was wanted by prosecutors for drug trafficking, charges his lawyer denied. Reuters found no evidence of wrongdoing by Kushner, who is not directly involved in the villagers' dispute. Political analyst Afrim Krasniqi said younger generations saw no future in Albania. "They see that all resources in the country, political resources, economic, everything is in the hands of oligarchs," he told Reuters. Corruption scandals have tarnised Albania's image over the years and analysts say the country is a hub for gangs seeking to launder money from drugs and weapons trafficking, complicating its efforts to join the EU. Along with Montenegro, Albania is leading the accession process among Balkan countries. The unrest is part of a wave of student activism in Europe. In France, high school students [USN:L1N45Z0DG TEXT:"have staged weeks of protests"] and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education.

item.title: El papa León XIV se presentará en público el domingo tras una "mejora constante", dice el Vaticano
item.description: El papa León XIV muestra una mejoría constante en el hospital tras someterse esta semana a una intervención quirúrgica por cáncer de pulmón, informó el Vaticano el viernes, añadiendo que ya es capaz de realizar sus actividades diarias con total autonomía.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El papa León XIV muestra una mejoría constante en el hospital tras someterse esta semana a una intervención quirúrgica por cáncer de pulmón, informó el Vaticano el viernes, añadiendo que ya es capaz de realizar sus actividades diarias con total autonomía. El Santo Padre hará su primera aparición pública desde su hospitalización el domingo para dirigir la tradicional oración del Ángelus, mientras continúan los preparativos para su viaje a Sudamérica previsto para noviembre, informó el Vaticano. A León XIV le diagnosticaron un adenocarcinoma de pulmón, el tipo más común de cáncer de pulmón, y los médicos le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho en una operación el martes. El Vaticano publicó el viernes las primeras imágenes del Sumo Pontífice desde su intervención quirúrgica, en las que se le ve celebrando misa y de pie sin ayuda. "Por el momento, no hemos recibido ninguna comunicación de los médicos sobre su alta, aparte de lo que se nos indicó desde el principio acerca de un plazo de una semana", dijo un portavoz del Vaticano. León XIV, de 71 años, tiene previsto visitar Uruguay, Argentina y Perú del 6 al 17 de noviembre. La presidenta peruana, Keiko Fujimori, había especulado con que el viaje podría tener que aplazarse, pero, en una señal de que los preparativos seguían su curso con normalidad, el Vaticano publicó una lista de periodistas acreditados para cubrir la visita. Los preparativos del viaje "siguen adelante", afirmó el portavoz del Vaticano.

item.title: Trump diz que EUA podem precisar atacar a Montanha Pickaxe no Irã
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que os EUA talvez tenham que atacar a Montanha Pickaxe, um local ligado ao programa nuclear do Irã, já que seu objetivo é garantir que Teerã não obtenha uma arma nuclear.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que os EUA talvez tenham que atacar a Montanha Pickaxe, um local ligado ao programa nuclear do Irã, já que seu objetivo é garantir que Teerã não obtenha uma arma nuclear. Em entrevista à Newsmax na noite de quinta-feira, Trump também disse que não usaria uma arma nuclear na guerra contra o Irã, que começou em fevereiro com ataques conjuntos dos EUA e de Israel. Trump declarou que os EUA querem garantir que o Irã nunca tenha uma arma nuclear “porque, se eles a tivessem, a usariam”. “O programa nuclear deles está enterrado sob milhões de toneladas de rocha. Agora estamos de olho na Montanha Pickaxe. Talvez tenhamos que ir até lá. Vamos tentar atacá-la. Vamos derrubá-la rapidamente”, disse Trump ao veículo de notícias. A Montanha Pickaxe é uma instalação fortificada enterrada nas profundezas do subsolo, perto de uma das principais instalações nucleares de Teerã. O presidente dos EUA afirmou que não havia necessidade de usar uma bomba nuclear no Irã. “Eu não usaria armas nucleares. Não precisamos disso.” Trump reiterou que não está considerando o uso de tropas terrestres dos EUA no Irã. Trump não disse se havia autorizado o uso da bomba GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast, também conhecida como a “mãe de todas as bombas”, contra a infraestrutura energética e as instalações nucleares iranianas. Ele afirmou, porém, que a bomba MOAB não era uma bomba nuclear.

item.title: Will a new leader and a new name boost the rebellion in eastern Congo?
item.description: The former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Joseph Kabila, took over leadership of rebel forces occupying eastern regions this week, in the most significant shake-up of the uprising in years.
item.dc:creator: Clement Bonnerot
item.content:encoded: The former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Joseph Kabila, [USN:L8N45Y1LU TEXT:"took over leadership"] of rebel forces [USN:L6N3XE158 TEXT:"occupying eastern regions"] this week, in the most significant shake-up of the uprising in years. The move gives the rebels a highly prominent Congolese figurehead and could boost their efforts to present themselves as a national movement rather than a Rwandan proxy, diplomats, rebel sources and analysts said. The big questions now are whether Kabila can translate his political stature and regional connections into broader support for the rebellion, and whether his leadership will significantly alter the balance of power on the ground in the fractured country. WHAT DOES KABILA'S LEADERSHIP CHANGE? The most obvious change is the name. After Monday's announcement of Kabila's new role, the rebels — an alliance of the Alliance Fleuve Congo coalition and the M23 armed group — said they would now be known as the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN). The name suggests a greater focus on national Congolese, not regional, affairs. Even before the leadership change, the rebels said their main aim was to remove Congo's current president, Felix Tshisekedi, from power, accusing his administration of corruption, discriminatory policies and crackdowns on opponents. But UN experts and analysts said the violence has been primarily driven by [USN:L5N3OP1EO TEXT:"long conflicts"] over power, identity and resources dating back to the 1990s genocide in neighbouring Rwanda and even earlier. Western countries and UN experts have accused Kigali of backing M23. Rwanda denies the allegations, but has acknowledged coordinating with the rebels on security matters. Much of the rebel leadership remains in place. Kabila takes over as president, while former Alliance Fleuve Congo coordinator Corneille Nangaa and M23 political leader Bertrand Bisimwa become vice presidents. Veteran M23 leader Sultani Makenga also takes a vice-presidential role, and remains chief of the rebel armed wing, preserving his central role in the movement. WHY IS KABILA STILL IMPORTANT YEARS AFTER HE LEFT POWER? The appointment of Kabila — who led Congo from 2001 to 2019 — puts a high-profile Congolese face on the rebellion. It could also broaden the rebellion's appeal beyond its eastern stronghold. Kabila is from the southern Katanga region, where there is mounting resentment towards the administration of his successor as president, Tshisekedi. But the rebellion has not yet reached the province. Kabila also brings greater political weight than Nangaa, as well as influential connections in Congo and beyond, particularly in Namibia, Kenya, South Africa and other parts of the region, which he regularly visits. But it is not yet clear if they would translate into tangible support. HOW WILL THIS AFFECT THE REBELLION ON THE GROUND? It remains to be seen how much support Kabila will be able to rally around the rebellion. After remaining in power for two years beyond his mandate, Kabila left office deeply unpopular in much of Congo, including in Katanga. His political network has weakened in recent years. Many former allies have switched allegiance to Tshisekedi, gone into exile or been imprisoned. Since Monday's announcement, several prominent figures from his political camp have publicly broken ranks with him. A Congolese court [USN:L5N3VH1AZ TEXT:"sentenced Kabila to death"] in absentia for treason a year ago after allegations that he had joined the rebels. He was also placed under US sanctions in April for providing material support to the rebels and destabilizing eastern Congo. A 2021 investigation by international media outlets and anti-corruption groups based on millions of leaked bank documents showed that Kabila and his family amassed significant wealth during his nearly two decades in power. It is not clear where this money is held and how he could mobilise it. WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR PEACE TALKS? AFC/M23 had been negotiating with the Congolese government in Qatari-mediated talks and signed a declaration last year committing both sides to a permanent ceasefire and broader peace negotiations. The FRN said on Wednesday it "assumes all of the rights, obligations, and commitments" of AFC/M23, "including those undertaken in the context of the Doha negotiations." At a UN Security Council meeting on Tuesday, Congo stressed the need for all parties to make good on promises, while the US called for the pursuit of negotiations. It remains unclear how much either side is committed to the peace process, with both blaming the other for the continued fighting.

item.title: 'Wild-eyed' comedian Russell Brand tried to drag me into toilets, woman tells UK court
item.description: One of six women who accuse Russell Brand of sex offences told a London court on Friday that the British actor and comedian turned into a "wild-eyed maniac" when he tried to drag her into a toilet cubicle at her workplace.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: One of six women who accuse [USN:L8N4600OQ TEXT:"Russell Brand"] of sex offences told a London court on Friday that the British actor and comedian turned into a "wild-eyed maniac" when he tried to drag her into a toilet cubicle at her workplace. Brand, once one of Britain's most high-profile broadcasters and the former husband of US singer Katy Perry, is [USN:L1N4610E0 TEXT:"on trial accused"] of three counts of rape, three of sexual assault and one of indecent assault against six women between 1999 and 2009. The 51-year-old denies the allegations and told police after his arrest that he had never engaged in non-consensual sexual activity. The second of the complainants told London's Southwark Crown Court that in 2001 Brand had tried to pull her into the male toilets at MTV Europe, in London, where she was working. Initially she said she had exchanged "banter" with Brand about the T-shirt he was wearing, which she told him she liked, but she said his demeanour had changed after she accompanied him to show him where the bathrooms were located. She said Brand had been quite affable but then become "a wild-eyed maniac trying to pull me into the toilet". BRAND'S LAWYER SAYS INCIDENT 'SHORT-LIVED' "He grabbed me by the arm and started to pull me and said 'come on, come in with me'," she said. "He started to plead almost, 'go on, go on, come in'." She said although he had grabbed her arm hard she was able to wrench her arm free. "I said to him 'what are you doing, are you mad, let me go'," she told the court. She said when he realised "it wasn't happening" because she was too strong, he went into the toilets. The whole incident lasted about 20 seconds, she said. The woman did not report what had happened to her employer at the time, saying it would be just her word against his, but went to the police after seeing a 2023 documentary about Brand. His lawyer Ian Winter put it to her that Brand had pleaded with her to go into the toilet for some sort of sexual activity and had accepted she was not consenting, with her view of what had occurred changing after she had seen the documentary. It was a "very short-lived, very minor incident where he tried to get you into the lavatory and you refused and he left it there", he suggested. All six of the complainants, who are legally entitled to lifelong anonymity, came forward after the documentary, Judge Joel Bennathan told the jury on Thursday. The trial, which is expected to last around six weeks, continues.

item.title: Los precios de las importaciones estadounidenses suben más de lo previsto en septiembre
item.description: Los precios de las importaciones en Estados Unidos aumentaron más de lo previsto en septiembre, impulsados por el incremento de los costos de los productos energéticos y de otros bienes diversos, lo que constituye una prueba más del aumento de las presiones inflacionarias a medida que persiste el conflicto en Oriente Medio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los precios de las importaciones en Estados Unidos aumentaron más de lo previsto en septiembre, impulsados por el incremento de los costos de los productos energéticos y de otros bienes diversos, lo que constituye una prueba más del aumento de las presiones inflacionarias a medida que persiste el conflicto en Oriente Medio. Los precios de las importaciones subieron un 1,1% el mes pasado, tras repuntar un 0,5% (cifra revisada a la baja) en agosto, informó el viernes la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales del Departamento del Trabajo. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado que los precios de las importaciones, que excluyen los aranceles, aumentarían un 0,8% tras el avance del 0,7% informado inicialmente en agosto. En los 12 meses hasta septiembre, los precios de importación subieron un 8,1%, el mayor incremento desde julio de 2022, tras aumentar un 6,7% en agosto. El Gobierno informó esta semana de fuertes alzas en los precios al consumidor y a los productores, lo que convenció a los economistas de que la inflación se estaba extendiendo más allá del sector energético. La prolongada guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán ha colapsado las cadenas de suministro y mantiene elevados los precios del petróleo. A pesar del repunte de la inflación en septiembre, los mercados financieros seguían esperando que la Reserva Federal se abstuviera de subir las tasas de interés a finales de este mes y endureciera la política monetaria en diciembre. El banco central de Estados Unidos subió en septiembre su tasa de interés de referencia a un día en 25 puntos básicos, situándola en el rango del 3,75%-4,00%.

item.title: Shell acuerda la venta de su unidad de movilidad francesa a DCC Energy, según fuente
item.description: Shell firmó un acuerdo con DCC Energy, con sede en Dublín, para la venta prevista del negocio de movilidad de la gran petrolera británica en Francia, según una persona familiarizada con el asunto y documentos a los que tuvo acceso Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Stephanie Kelly, Dimitri Rhodes
item.content:encoded: Shell (SHEL.L) firmó un acuerdo con DCC Energy, con sede en Dublín, para la venta prevista del negocio de movilidad de la gran petrolera británica en Francia, según una persona familiarizada con el asunto y documentos a los que tuvo acceso Reuters. Las partes aún no han cerrado el acuerdo, aunque se espera que la operación se complete en el segundo trimestre de 2027, previa consulta con los representantes de los trabajadores, según se desprende del documento. La transacción incluiría alrededor de 70 estaciones de servicio, ocho instalaciones de GNL y la transferencia de 35 empleados, según el documento. "Shell está barajando la venta de su negocio de estaciones de servicio en Francia", declaró Shell a Reuters, añadiendo que no haría más comentarios en esta fase. DCC Energy, una empresa de ventas y distribución con presencia en Europa y Estados Unidos, presta servicio a millones de clientes de los sectores industrial y público y ofrece soluciones energéticas fuera de la red, principalmente a base de gas licuado, según indica la página web de la empresa. También gestiona estaciones de servicio y presta servicios a flotas. El valor monetario de la operación no se ha determinado de inmediato. La unidad de comercialización de Shell, que incluye sus estaciones de servicio y de recarga, registró unos beneficios ajustados de 1.300 millones de dólares en el segundo trimestre de este año, frente a los 1.200 millones de dólares del mismo periodo del año anterior.

item.title: Supermarket operator Ahold's websites, app remain offline 5 days after cyber incident
item.description: Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "cybersecurity incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold (AD.AS) remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "[USN:L8N45Z1DC TEXT:"cybersecurity"] incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems. An Ahold spokesperson said the parent company cannot comment about the situation at its individual chains. Its US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, are collectively one of the largest food retailers in the United States. Physical stores remain open. Ahold's Albert Heijn chain, the Netherlands' largest, has been gradually recovering from the shutdown that began October 11, disrupting its distribution centres and leading to empty produce shelves. Albert Heijn does not expect online delivery to resume [USN:L4N4611Y0 TEXT:"before Sunday."] The Netherlands' Justice Minister David van Weel called on the company on Friday to file a criminal complaint over the incident, which Ahold has avoided describing as a hack, saying in a statement that no "customer, associate and partner data was taken". "I understand that in the heat of the moment, a company like this is concerned with preventing damage to its systems and is not immediately looking outward," the minister told Dutch press agency ANP. "I think that we're in calmer waters now and the time has come to take this step." The Ahold spokesperson said the company could not respond to the politician's remarks and pointed to its most recent statement on October 14, in which it said the company was working with relevant internal teams and external cybersecurity experts and engaging with the appropriate authorities and other stakeholders as necessary. That statement said that because Ahold's investigation is ongoing, it could not share details about what happened in order not to undermine its own security or interfere with its response.

item.title: Russia says strategic bombers made planned flight over Baltic Sea, Interfax reports
item.description: Russian Tu-22M3 strategic bomber planes, escorted by fighter jets, carried out a planned flight over neutral waters of the Baltic Sea, Russian news agencies quoted the Defence Ministry as saying on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian Tu-22M3 strategic bomber planes, escorted by fighter jets, carried out a planned flight over neutral waters of the Baltic Sea, Russian news agencies quoted the Defence Ministry as saying on Friday. Foreign fighter jets escorted the bombers during parts of the flight, which lasted over four hours, the ministry said without specifying the reason for the mission. Russia periodically stages such flights to keep its nuclear-capable forces in a state of readiness and as a show of strength. Tensions are high in the Baltic region, where Russia [USN:L1N45M0BZ TEXT:"warned"] NATO last month that it would be ready to resort to nuclear weapons if the Western alliance attempted to cut off the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, which borders Poland and Lithuania.

item.title: Trump says US may need to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain
item.description: President Donald Trump said the US may have to target Pickaxe Mountain, a site linked to Iran's nuclear program, as he aims to ensure Tehran does not get a nuclear weapon. In an interview with Newsmax on Thursday night, Trump also said he would not use a nuclear weapon in the war on Iran, which began in February with US-Israeli strikes.

"I wouldn't use nuclear. item.title: Kenya's economy grows 5.1% year-on-year in second quarter of 2026
item.description: Kenya's economy grew 5.1% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, compared with 4.9% in the same period last year, the statistics office said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya's economy grew 5.1% year-on-year (KEGDPQ=ECI) in the second quarter of 2026, compared with 4.9% in the same period last year, the statistics office said on Friday. The growth was mainly supported by strong activity in sectors including transportation and storage, accommodation and food services. The transportation and storage sector grew by 4.4% compared with 3.3% in the second quarter of 2025. Other sectors that recorded notable growth included electricity, information and communication technologies, financial services and construction.

item.title: Warsh, do Fed, vê resiliência nos EUA, mas não se pronuncia sobre trajetória dos juros
item.description: O presidente do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, manifestou otimismo nesta sexta-feira quanto à solidez da economia dos EUA e surpresa com o fato de as economias globais terem se mantido tão bem em meio a contínuos choques energéticos e a uma política monetária mais restritiva para combater a inflação.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder, Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: O presidente do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, manifestou otimismo nesta sexta-feira quanto à solidez da economia dos EUA e surpresa com o fato de as economias globais terem se mantido tão bem em meio a contínuos choques energéticos e a uma política monetária mais restritiva para combater a inflação. Ele afirmou que os EUA e muitas outras economias estão se beneficiando de um “surto de investimentos” impulsionado pela inteligência artificial, mas que se estende a outros setores, criando um choque de demanda no curto prazo que está exercendo pressão ascendente sobre a inflação. “Saí das reuniões aqui ontem e hoje, e é difícil participar de uma discussão com banqueiros centrais sem trocar impressões e ouvir o mesmo sobre o aumento dos preços”, disse Warsh nas reuniões anuais do Fundo Monetário Internacional e do Banco Mundial, em Bangcoc. Com a inflação sendo um “desafio comum”, Warsh disse que os bancos centrais globais adotaram “um aperto sincronizado da política monetária na maioria dos lugares ao redor do mundo, e isso significa que não há quem fique de fora”. Nos EUA, disse ele, “deixamos bem claro que garantiríamos a estabilidade de preços e retiramos uma dose de acomodação há cerca de um mês”, em referência ao aumento da taxa de juros pelo Fed em setembro. SEM PREVISÃO SOBRE TRAJETÓRIA DOS JUROS Mas, mantendo o estilo que vem adotando desde que assumiu o comando do Fed em maio, ele não deu nenhuma indicação sobre se acredita que serão necessários mais aumentos nas taxas de juros, nem quando. “Não antecipo o resultado das reuniões”, acrescentou Warsh na discussão com a diretora-geral do FMI, Kristalina Georgieva. “Não acredito em dizer agora o que posso vir a fazer nas reuniões que teremos no restante deste ano.” Os pares de Warsh no Fed não têm se mostrado reticentes quanto às suas opiniões sobre a trajetória das taxas. Nas últimas semanas, quase todos afirmaram que provavelmente será necessário um maior aperto monetário, mas a maioria disse querer analisar mais dados econômicos para avaliar a tendência da inflação. Os mercados financeiros levaram essas falas em conta e apostam que o Fed vai esperar até dezembro para aumentar as taxas. Isso se manteve mesmo depois que relatórios divulgados nesta semana mostraram que dois indicadores diferentes de inflação estavam acima do esperado e se distanciando da meta de 2% do Fed. A decisão de Warsh de evitar completamente a discussão sobre a decisão de política monetária no curto prazo e se ater a temas econômicos mais amplos mantém intacta a expectativa de que o Fed não aumentará as taxas neste mês. CAMINHO “ACIDENTADO” DA IA RUMO A MAIS RIQUEZA Warsh mostrou-se otimista quanto ao impacto da IA no crescimento econômico e na produtividade no médio prazo, mesmo afirmando que será um caminho “muito acidentado” rumo ao que ele espera ser um crescimento mais rápido da produtividade na “economia real”, o que impulsionaria a riqueza. “É óbvio que ela está afetando o lado da demanda da economia antes de afetar o lado da oferta”, disse ele. “Não sabemos qual será o efeito sobre o emprego nos próximos 12 ou 18 meses, mas se você acredita, como eu acredito, que ela tornará as economias e os países que a utilizarem bem mais produtivos, e que isso fará com que tenhamos mais riqueza, então isso tem que ser algo muito bom.” Um grupo de trabalho convocado para assessorar o Fed sobre o impacto da IA na produtividade e no emprego realizará uma “audiência de campo” na região da Baía de San Francisco no dia 16 de novembro, disse ele, no que será uma primeira amostra pública do trabalho do grupo. SAINDO MAIS FORTES Ele disse que a ampliação do surto de investimentos para além da IA está proporcionando certa resiliência ao crescimento dos EUA. “Isso significa que temos muitos fatores favoráveis que estão dando força e durabilidade a esta economia”, disse ele. “Esse tipo de impulso certamente não é encontrado em todas as partes do mundo.” Mas a economia global também está “demonstrando resiliência que não sei se teria previsto há cinco ou seis meses, considerando o que está acontecendo na geopolítica e nos pontos críticos ao redor do mundo”. O FMI afirmou no início desta semana que os investimentos em IA manterão o crescimento global acima de 3% neste ano, compensando em parte o impacto negativo dos preços do petróleo, que oscilam acima de US$100 por barril, mas que os riscos decorrentes dos altos níveis de endividamento e de uma possível queda acentuada nos investimentos em IA e nos valores dos ativos ameaçam as perspectivas. Warsh afirmou que os representantes dos bancos centrais reunidos em Bangcoc compartilhavam uma visão comum de salvaguardar a estabilidade de preços e estão tomando medidas para apoiar essa visão, o que está proporcionando “confiança às empresas e às famílias, algo tão importante para que o crescimento continue”. “Acredito, com otimismo — você pode achar que é ingenuidade —, que, pelo menos nos Estados Unidos, sairemos dessa situação mais fortes, com uma economia mais duradoura e mais capaz de liderar o mundo em termos de crescimento econômico”, disse Warsh.

item.title: Lions player dies before Champions Cup debut in France
item.description: A player from South Africa’s Lions rugby team died on Friday at the team's hotel in France, the day before the club are due to make their debut in the European Champions Cup away at La Rochelle.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A player from South Africa’s Lions rugby team died on Friday at the team's hotel in France, the day before the club are due to make their debut in the European Champions Cup away at La Rochelle. The identity of the player has not been announced while the team contacts his family in South Africa, SA Rugby officials told Reuters on Friday. French media reports said the player was found unconscious in a shower cubicle at a hotel on the Ile de Re in France, where the team had been staying since Tuesday. Emergency services were called shortly after 10 a.m. and attended to the player, who was in cardiorespiratory arrest. Attempts to resuscitate him were unsuccessful, the reports added. Saturday’s match is now in doubt, along with two United Rugby Championship fixtures the Lions are scheduled to play in Scotland over the next fortnight. The Lions did not respond to requests for comment. European Professional Club Rugby confirmed no decision had yet been made on the La Rochelle fixture and that it would consult the Lions. The death comes 10 years to the day after Munster coach Anthony Foley passed away at the age of 42 in his Paris hotel ahead of a Heineken Cup match against compatriot Ronan O’Gara’s Racing 92. O’Gara is now the coach of La Rochelle and according to Irish media visited the Lions at their hotel on Friday to offer his condolences.

item.title: US import prices increase more than expected in September
item.description: US import prices increased more than expected in September, boosted by higher costs for energy products and a range of other goods, further evidence of rising inflation pressures as the Middle East conflict persists.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US import prices increased more than expected in September, boosted by higher costs for energy products and a range of other goods, further evidence of rising inflation pressures as the Middle East conflict persists. Import prices jumped 1.1% last month after rebounding by a downwardly revised 0.5% in August, the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics said on Friday. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast import prices, which exclude tariffs, increasing 0.8% after a previously reported 0.7% advance in August. In the 12 months through September, import prices rose 8.1%, the largest increase since July 2022, after increasing 6.7% in August. The government this week reported strong increases in consumer and producer prices, which left economists convinced that inflation was broadening beyond the energy sector. The dragging US-Israeli war with Iran has snarled supply chains, and is keeping oil prices elevated. Despite inflation heating up in September, financial markets still expected the Federal Reserve to skip raising interest rates later this month and tighten monetary policy in December. The US central bank in September raised its [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"overnight benchmark interest rate"] by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range.

item.title: Hazlewood says reverse swing may be a factor in South Africa test series
item.description: Australia fast bowler Josh Hazlewood predicts reverse swing may be crucial to the outcome of the three-test series against South Africa, where abrasive pitches are helping revive a fading art.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia fast bowler Josh Hazlewood predicts reverse swing may be crucial to the outcome of the three-test series against South Africa, where abrasive pitches are helping revive a fading art. Hazlewood extracted swing and used the reversing ball to good effect in the first test at Kingsmead in Durban, which ended on Tuesday with Australia winning by 214 runs. Reverse swing could be as vital for the second test in Gqeberha, which starts on Sunday and where the St George's Park wickets are expected to be similar. The art of reverse swing has faded in recent years with greener wickets and lusher outfields keeping the ball newer and less likely to rough up. “The ball still looks new late in the innings if it gets that far,” said Hazlewood about playing back home in Australia, but it is a different story on tour in South Africa. “It’s abrasive wickets. It's very hard underfoot,” he explained. "We probably got a hint of swing in the first innings and then as the game goes it just deteriorates more and you get a bit more. So we knew it was crucial," he said of their success in Durban, where he returned carer-best figure of 6-49 in the last innings to secure Australia’s triumph. "If the wicket is hard, firm, deteriorating and not much seam movement, you're probably going to get that reverse swing," Hazlewood told a pitch-side press conference on Friday as Australia prepared for Sunday. "You probably want the ball a bit harder and a little bit of reverse swing rather than a lot of reverse swing and the ball's soft. That's much easier to navigate as a batsman,” he added. Hazlewood, now 35, produced his performance in Durban after missing all of last season's Ashes series through injury. “I just play every test match that comes,” he said of his longevity. "Could be your last one whenever. I don’t think about it much. "I think you know it was great fun last week playing with the same guys. Doing the work in the last innings and taking the 20 wickets for the game on what was a pretty flat wicket for the majority. I don’t look too far ahead these days.”

item.title: Policía india detiene a Dipke, fundador del movimiento de las "cucarachas", antes de manifestación
item.description: La policía india detuvo el viernes a Abhijeet Dipke, fundador del movimiento de las "cucarachas", según mostraron imágenes en vivo difundidas por su grupo, antes de una manifestación convocada por él en el distrito financiero central de la capital, Delhi, la última concentración para exigir la dimisión del presidente de la Comisión Electoral.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La policía india detuvo el viernes a Abhijeet Dipke, fundador del movimiento de las "cucarachas", según mostraron imágenes en vivo difundidas por su grupo, antes de una manifestación convocada por él en el distrito financiero central de la capital, Delhi, la última concentración para exigir la dimisión del presidente de la Comisión Electoral. El Partido Cucarachas Janta (CJP), liderado por jóvenes, junto con grupos de la oposición y organizaciones estudiantiles, ha llevado a cabo protestas casi a diario este mes para exigir la dimisión del presidente de la Comisión Electoral, Gyanesh Kumar, a raíz de una revisión de las listas electorales que, según los críticos, favorece al Partido Bharatiya Janata (BJP) del primer ministro Narendra Modi. Más de 130 millones de votantes fueron eliminados durante la revisión, pero la Comisión Electoral negó haber favorecido a ningún partido y dijo que los votantes eliminados por error pueden reinscribirse. El BJP acusó a sus rivales de intentar socavar la democracia al cuestionar de forma indebida procesos electorales legítimos. Dipke convocó la protesta del viernes en apoyo a dos líderes del CJP detenidos y encarcelados esta semana durante cinco días por manifestarse en un lugar de protesta, infringiendo así una prohibición. El grupo y organizaciones estudiantiles de izquierdas habían instado a sus simpatizantes a reunirse el viernes por la tarde en el Central Park, situado en el concurrido barrio comercial y gastronómico de Connaught Place, en Nueva Delhi, para ondear e izar la bandera nacional. El video en directo publicado en la cuenta de Instagram del CJP mostró a Dipke saliendo de una casa y caminando hacia la calle, donde unos agentes de policía lo detuvieron y, tras una breve discusión, lo subieron a un auto patrulla y se lo llevaron. "Te estamos deteniendo ahora mismo", dijo un agente a Dipke. "No he infringido ninguna ley ahora mismo... ¿cómo pueden detenerme?", preguntó Dipke a los agentes mientras se lo llevaban. La policía no hizo ningún comentario inmediato sobre la detención. El viernes por la mañana, la policía se reunió con Dipke y le advirtió que no siguiera adelante con la protesta.

item.title: 'A good day for motorists and for jobs': Reactions to Germany-France car deal
item.description: France and Germany have struck a deal on cars to water down EU-wide CO2 emission targets for 2035 and open the door for Britain to be treated as a trusted partner under the EU's Made in EU rules, the two countries said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France and Germany have struck a deal on cars to water down EU-wide CO2 emission targets for 2035 and open the door for Britain to be treated as a trusted partner under the EU's [USN:L6N45E0Q1 TEXT:""Made in EU" rules"], the two countries said on Friday. Below are some comments on the deal: FRIEDRICH MERZ, CHANCELLOR OF GERMANY ON X: "A good day for motorists and for jobs in Germany, France and Europe. @EmmanuelMacron and I have agreed on a package covering freedom of choice, technology openness and the safeguarding of climate targets. This sends a pro-investment signal to the industry." LARS KLINGBEIL, GERMAN FINANCE MINISTER: "We have made the right decisions for the hundreds of thousands of employees and the sites of the German automotive industry. We have ensured that domestic production will be strengthened. That means: more 'made in Germany' and 'made in Europe.' We do not want Germany to merely assemble components from Asia, but rather to have key components developed and produced here." "Now it is the economy's turn. Our expectation is very clear: automobile manufacturers have a responsibility to invest in the future of German sites and to secure jobs." SWANTJE MICHAELSEN, GERMAN GREENS MP SPECIALISING IN TRANSPORT POLICY: "The federal government is holding back the German automotive industry instead of supporting it. It is not the end of the internal combustion engine that is outdated, but the chancellor's assumptions. He is negotiating the future of the auto industry without taking current market trends sufficiently into account and, apparently, without consulting his coalition partner." "Anyone who weakens the 2035 targets now creates new uncertainty and jeopardizes the competitiveness of the German auto industry. Anyone who slows down electric mobility today risks falling behind tomorrow. Germany must shape this transformation instead of holding it back." OLAF LIES, PREMIER OF GERMAN STATE LOWER SAXONY, WHICH IS SECOND-LARGEST SHAREHOLDER IN VOLKSWAGEN "The agreement between Chancellor Merz and President Macron sends a strong signal to the automotive industry in Europe, and it is encouragingly clear-cut. For us, one thing is key: it secures jobs—at manufacturers, among suppliers, and at our plants in Lower Saxony. At the same time, it strengthens future markets such as batteries and green steel, which are already emerging today, particularly in Salzgitter." "And a second point is important to us: We are strengthening "Made in Europe." If government subsidies and public contracts are linked to European value creation in the future, production and value creation will remain right here with us. With a 90 percent reduction in CO₂ emissions without an obligation to offset, the 2035 target also becomes realistic." TOYOTA'S EUROPEAN DIVISION: "We welcome any discussion on the inclusion of the UK but we would like to see this deal expanded to other trusted partners — such as Turkey and Japan — whose continued close collaboration can support European competitiveness in the automotive industry. Critical future investment considerations, like the current battery production study, would benefit from wider inclusion." ANNA KRAJINSKA, SENIOR DIRECTOR FOR VEHICLES AND INDUSTRIAL TRANSFORMATION AT T&E: "Germany and France are making a historic mistake. German and French political leaders claim they are acting to save jobs, but this may well be the deal that buries Europe's auto industry." "Europe needs to rapidly cut its dependence on imported oil, deliver affordable EVs and give industry a clear reason to invest in electric cars and their supply chains. This is crucial for delivering good quality jobs for Europeans." "Yet this agreement drastically slows down on EV sales and takes the teeth out of the Industrial Accelerator Act. The car CO2 standards and the IAA are the last chance to halt the decline of Europe’s auto manufacturing, with this agreement, it is impossible to see how this will be achieved."

item.title: Futuro Congresso inclinado à direita se prepara para embate com STF
item.description: O próximo Congresso, eleito no último dia 4 de outubro, está se preparando para um embate com o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), incluindo planos para um impeachment sem precedentes de um de seus ministros, o que poderia ampliar drasticamente o alcance de uma agenda de direita, disseram à Reuters mais de uma dezena de especialistas e funcionários do Senado e do Judiciário.
item.dc:creator: Ricardo Brito
item.content:encoded: O próximo Congresso, eleito no último dia 4 de outubro, está se preparando para um embate com o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), incluindo planos para um impeachment sem precedentes de um de seus ministros, o que poderia ampliar drasticamente o alcance de uma agenda de direita, disseram à Reuters mais de uma dezena de especialistas e funcionários do Senado e do Judiciário. À frente dessa iniciativa estão aliados do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que dominaram as eleições legislativas deste mês e estão ávidos por vingança contra Alexandre de Moraes, o ministro do Supremo responsável pela prisão e condenação do ex-presidente por conspiração golpista. Isso representaria uma escalada significativa do Poder Legislativo em uma luta de poder que já dura anos com o Judiciário, reafirmando a influência do Congresso e potencialmente empurrando o tribunal para a direita nos próximos anos. Se o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), filho do ex-presidente, derrotar o atual presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, em 25 de outubro, um Judiciário enfraquecido também reduziria um dos principais mecanismos de controle do seu poder. BLOQUEANDO POLÍTICAS DE DIREITA O STF foi o principal obstáculo à agenda de Bolsonaro durante seu mandato na Presidência de 2019 a 2022, bloqueando iniciativas para enfraquecer as proteções ambientais, flexibilizar as restrições da pandemia e facilitar a compra de armas, por exemplo. O Supremo continua a barrar algumas das legislações de direita mais estridentes, definindo efetivamente políticas em assuntos que vão desde os direitos dos povos indígenas até a regulamentação da internet. A eleição deste mês poderá ser crucial, já que o próximo presidente poderá nomear pelo menos quatro dos 11 ministros do Supremo, incluindo uma vaga já existente e substitutos para três ministros que atingirão a idade de aposentadoria compulsória de 75 anos antes do término do próximo mandato presidencial. Após Bolsonaro ter indicado dois ministros para o Supremo, uma vitória de seu filho pode significar uma maioria na corte composta por indicados pela família Bolsonaro até o final de seu mandato, no início de 2031. O impeachment de Moraes, de 57 anos, aceleraria a chegada dessa maioria. "Caso Flávio vença, o próximo governo e o Senado poderão reformular a maioria dos 11 membros do Supremo, o que significa definir, literalmente, o equilíbrio de poder na democracia brasileira por uma geração", disse Bruna Santos, diretora do Programa Brasil do Diálogo Interamericano. CRÍTICAS DE TRUMP E MUSK O processo contra o ex-presidente Bolsonaro, relatado por Moraes, fez dele uma das figuras mais controversas do Brasil, atraindo até mesmo a ira do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, que descreveu o caso como uma "caça às bruxas" e chegou a sancionar o magistrado brevemente em 2025. Moraes também foi alvo de críticas quando ordenou a suspensão do X no Brasil em 2024, após a plataforma desrespeitar ordens judiciais. O proprietário do X, Elon Musk, o acusou de censura e autoritarismo. Apoiadores de Bolsonaro se mobilizam para exigir a destituição do magistrado após um relatório da Polícia Federal revelar comunicações entre Moraes e Daniel Vorcaro, dono do Banco Master preso acusado da maior fraude bancária da história do país. Flávio, que também está sendo investigado por ligações com Vorcaro, também pediu a remoção de Moraes. "Defender o Judiciário significa enfrentar esse problema — abrir um processo de impeachment e dar-lhe o direito à defesa, concluí-lo e virar a página", disse à Reuters o senador eleito Domingos Sávio (PL-MG). Após hesitar num primeiro momento em adotar uma postura mais firme, Lula passou a manifestar publicamente seu apoio à abertura de uma apuração sobre ministros do Supremo, defendendo transparência, divulgação e uma investigação imparcial de todas as suspeitas de corrupção. Nem Moraes nem o Supremo responderam às perguntas da Reuters. O ministro e o restante do tribunal têm defendido suas ações como necessárias para fazer cumprir a lei brasileira e proteger as instituições democráticas. Moraes refere-se às investigações que o envolvem como politicamente e eleitoralmente motivadas, como vingança pela condenação de Bolsonaro, e solicitou uma investigação sobre André Mendonça, ministro do STF que divulgou os relatórios que o implicam. PODER DE FOGO LEGISLATIVO O candidato a vice-presidente de Flávio Bolsonaro, o deputado Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), disse à Reuters que "é preciso rever o que está acontecendo hoje na relação entre o Supremo Tribunal Federal e os demais Poderes, e isso envolve examinar se os ministros cometeram crimes passíveis de impeachment". A Constituição brasileira permite que o Senado julgue ministros do STF por infrações que violem a Constituição. São necessários dois terços dos 81 senadores — ou seja, 54 deles — para condenar e destituir um ministro. Os aliados de Flávio podem já estar próximos desse número quando o próximo Senado tomar posse em fevereiro. Seu partido conquistou um número recorde de 28 cadeiras, e o senador já garantiu o apoio de outros cinco partidos que, juntos, detêm mais 22 cadeiras. Isso elevaria a coligação que o apoia para 50 senadores. Os quatro votos restantes poderiam vir dos 15 senadores de partidos não alinhados. Desde 2023, houve 48 pedidos malsucedidos de impeachment de Moraes no Senado, que nunca chegaram a julgamento porque o presidente do Senado não deu seguimento às denúncias. Isso pode mudar, já que o coordenador de campanha de Flávio, Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), provavelmente se tornará o próximo presidente do Senado. Nos últimos dias, Marinho disse a jornalistas que o Senado não buscará oportunidades para vingança, embora tenha acrescentado que o atual Senado "está falhando em agir" para responsabilizar os ministros do STF. "Se forem cometidos crimes passíveis de impeachment, eles devem ser investigados. Ninguém está acima da lei", disse Marinho. (Reportagem de Ricardo Brito; Reportagem adicional de Brendan O'Boyle)
